limits: Both virtual monitors used scale 1. Mixed DPI, negative origins and monitor gaps were not verified.
A single native desktop surface spans the monitor bounding rectangle; per-monitor independent desktop grids are not implemented.
This private integration test did not alter the current user desktop or preferences.
The custom wallpaper file chooser result was a private fixture; original UI Browse and apply code were exercised.
GNOME/DING test logs contain expected private-session service warnings and warnings caused by deliberately terminating the private desktop renderer.
